title: proMCP read_* response
description: Response contract for all read_* tools in a proMCP-compliant MCP server. Read tools are side-effect-free, parallelizable, and retryable. The quality field is required and governs whether the orchestrator may act on the value.

value.description: The observed value. May be any type. NULL when quality is 'error'.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime at which the value was observed.

quality.description: Reliability and freshness of the observed value. 'good': fresh from reliable source — safe to act on. 'stale': beyond cache TTL, no fresher data available — act with caution. 'degraded': source operational but outside normal parameters — escalate to human review. 'error': read failed, value is absent or unreliable — MUST NOT act.

unit.description: Unit of measurement for numeric values. Examples: celsius, percent, pascal, lux, units, USD. NULL for non-numeric or unitless values.
